text: replicate bootstrap draws n rows replacement original data refits OLS resample. Writing estimate replicate r vector refitted coefficients, bootstrap standard error coefficient standard deviation replicate values. boot_pairs() offers three interval types: "percentile" uses empirical quantiles replicates, "basic" (reverse percentile) reflects quantiles original estimate, "normal" uses estimate plus minus normal quantile times bootstrap standard error.

text: model uses PublicSchools2 data, complete observations 51 states, includes south indicator original PublicSchools data lack.

text: two-step estimator Harvey (1976) begins OLS residuals \hat e_t regresses \log(\hat e_t^2) dispersion regressors Z. expectation \log \varepsilon^2 normality zero, intercept auxiliary regression bias-corrected adding c = -\operatorname{digamma}(1/2) - \log 2 \approx 1.2704, bias \log \varepsilon^2 normality. fitted log-variances yield weights \hat w_t = \exp(-z_t^\top \hat\gamma), single weighted least squares pass weights delivers mean coefficients, reported dispersion covariance \tfrac{\pi^2}{2}(Z^\top Z)^{-1}.

text: gls_mult() fits linear model feasible generalized least squares conditional variance modelled exponential function dispersion regressors. title: Heteroskedasticity-consistent covariance estimator — vcov_hc
text: linear model design matrix \(X\), OLS residuals \(\hat e_t\), HC weights \(g_t\), estimator $$\widehat{\Psi}_{HC} = (X'X)^{-1} X' \widehat{\Omega} X (X'X)^{-1},$$ \(\widehat{\Omega} = diag(\hat e_t^2 g_t)\). supported estimators "hc0", "hc1", "hc2", "hc3", "hc4", "hc4m", "hc5", "hc5m", "hcbeta". Additional arguments ... method-specific. defaults : "hc0", "hc1", "hc2", "hc3", "hc4", "hc4m": method-specific arguments. "hc5": k = 0.7.
